title: Interrogate the trail
headline: The audit log answered, and the receipt verified cryptographically

steps.label: Question over the audit trail
steps.detail: 「Why was the payout to NewVendor blocked? What would approve it?」

steps.label: Answer from the trail (records + mandate)
steps.detail: All three attempts were blocked by rule R-02 (payee not on the signed allowlist): seq 109 at 08:37 (v9, payee newvendor@unverified.test), seq 129 at 09:18 (v11), and seq 195 at 10:56 (v15, payee "NewVendor", $800 USD). The stated reason is that no approval path exists for R-02 — the only fix is to edit the mandate and re-sign it, adding the exact payee to the allowlist. Note that even under the current mandate v17 the allowlist is only sam@contractor.test, vita@va.test, and acme@client.test, so the payout would still be blocked until NewVendor's exact payee identifier is added and the mandate re-signed.

steps.label: Counterfactual
steps.detail: Adding NewVendor to your allowlist (which re-signs the mandate as a new version) would have allowed this action.
